description: This is a vintage Quasar television with a wood-grain finish. The screen is large and appears to be made of glass, with a slightly cloudy or textured surface, suggesting it's either an older CRT model or has a matte finish. There are two prominent rotary knobs on the right side, likely for channel selection and volume or settings. Below the screen, there's a control panel with several smaller buttons and sliders, labeled with functions such as 'Sharpness', 'Picture', 'Bright', 'Hue', 'Contrast', and 'Off/On'. A speaker grille is integrated into the right side of the unit. The television sits on a white, somewhat damaged or worn base, hinting at its age and perhaps being part of a larger display or prop.
